# Results numbers inventory

Every number that will appear in the paper, with the file and column it came
from. **An index of what exists. Nothing here was computed for this file.**

**Every number below is regenerated by a script in this directory.** There are
no session only values. That was checked: the eight numbers that once existed
only in a chat log were folded into `match_ground_truth.py`, the script was
rerun, and all eight reproduced exactly.

Paths are relative to `tile-grid-phase/`. Where a number is printed by a script
rather than written to a column, the script is named and the column reads
`printed`.

Read this before retyping any figure. Do not take a number from a chat log.

---

## The sentence the results section turns on

| number | value | source | column |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| recall, scoring set 1 | 34.4 percent | `ground_truth/match_metrics.csv` | `recall`, row `1 live canopy certain, not edge clipped` |
| tree level detection rate, scoring set 1 | 90.6 percent | `ground_truth/match_metrics.csv` | `tree_detection_rate`, same row |
| true positives behind the recall | 22 of 64 | `ground_truth/match_metrics.csv` | `tp`, `n_ann` |

The two rates have **different denominators and different units**. Recall is per
annotation under a one to one Hungarian rule at IoU 0.5. Tree rate is per
annotation under a 50 percent containment rule. They are not combinable and
neither is a component of the other.

## Numbers that appear in more than one place

Checked for conflicts. Three entries need care.

**1. Detection counts, 274 against 296.** The core count for dx225_dy075 is
**274**, and every matching number uses it. `phase_boxes_dx225_dy075.csv` has
**296** rows, because the file holds the full scored window and the core filter
at inset 25 removes 22. **Quote 274. Never the row count of the CSV.**

**2. Per position spread, cv 0.0245 against 0.0269.** 0.0245 is over the 15 non
zero positions and is the one to quote. 0.0269 is over all 16 and mixes phase
0's 25 tile regime into the others. Both appear in the README. The 15 position
figure spans two regimes itself, 20 tiles at six positions and 16 at nine, so
the word "comparable" does not apply to it either.

**3. Percentages that move with the matching threshold.** The all 16 share is
16.20 percent at IoU 0.5 and 23.52 percent at 0.3. The singleton count is 196
at 0.5 and 129 at 0.3. **Quote 0.5 throughout the paper, and quote 0.3 only
when explicitly naming the conservative case.** The 2 to 15 band near 55
percent and the median support of 4.0 are the two figures that do not move.

No other number in this inventory appears twice with different values.

---

## Numbers deliberately absent

- Anything about the 164 clusters at supports 5 to 15 beyond their count and
  their pinned share. They are unexplained and go in as a stated limitation.
- Any accuracy claim resting on the annotation being correct. One annotator, no
  field verification, photo interpretation of nadir RGB. See
  `ANNOTATION_PROTOCOL.md` section 8.
- Any false positive rate. Detections outside the annotations cannot be read as
  false positives while a third of the chip is unannotated.
- Any figure combining precision, recall, tree rate or containment rate
  arithmetically. Different denominators, different units.
